name: kvt-framework
description: Renderer-independent TypeScript runtime, lifecycle, Flow and application architecture tools.
author: Araik Gukasyan

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:packages && npm run build:examples --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @kvt/eslint-plugin && npm run build -w @kvt/flow && npm run build -w @kvt/core && npm run build -w @kvt/theme-core && npm run build -w @kvt/devtools-protocol && npm run build -w @kvt/query && npm run build -w @kvt/react && npm run build -w @kvt/router-react && npm run build -w @kvt/theme-react && npm run build -w @kvt/theme-tailwind && npm run build -w @kvt/otel && npm run build -w @kvt/devtools-react && npm run build -w @kvt/testing && npm run build -w @kvt/testing-react && npm run build -w @kvt/cli && npm run build -w create-kvt
scripts.build:examples: npm run build -w @kvt/example-core && npm run build -w @kvt/example && npm run build -w @kvt/example-ssr
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:site:api && vitepress dev website
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:site:api && vitepress build website
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:coverage && npm run test:mutation && npm run build && npm run check:docs-contracts && npm run docs:api && npm run docs:build && npm run check:boundaries && npm run check:dependency-graph && npm run check:packages && npm run check:api && npm run check:package-quality && npm run check:bundle-size && npm run test:memory && npm run test:ssr-soak && npm run test:benchmarks
